title: Quitting stuff
body: This app helped me so much to quit my bad habits having an actual counter for certain things u havent used for some time gives u a motivation to keep going since u got some amount of days on your counter. I really recommend it!
author: Raymyyy

title: Everything costs money now
body:
They did it. Even putting up a widget costs premium now. (And no, grandfathering in existing users doesn’t make this okay, you guys know exactly what you are doing) It’s malicious, especially because it’s a habit breaking app. They are preying on the vulnerable and it’s honestly disgusting.
To have the audacity to ask for this much money for a simple app like this is honestly insane.
author: Dragoner7

title: Putting previously free core function behind a paywall
body: Previously I was able to have my counter as a widget on my screen, as a reassuring presence day to day and now it’s suddenly a premium feature.  Very disappointing
